quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a left turn where both intersecting highways are one-way, both the approach for the left turn and the left turn must be made as close as practicable to the left-hand curb or edge of the highway.

activation.condition: The driver intends a left turn at an intersection where both highways are one-way.

obligation.description: Approach and left turn remain as close as practicable to the left curb or edge.

timing.description: Observe approach, turn and departure in original frames.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The law supplies no numeric curb clearance or practicability cutoff.

parameter_refs.name: approach_offset_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: nonnegative requested offset from left edge in m

parameter_refs.name: departure_offset_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: nonnegative requested offset from left edge in m

parameter_refs.name: one_way_curb_gap_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: nonnegative measured full-body gap in m
